title: bomify plugin SecurityResult
description: The single JSON array a bomify-plugin-<type> binary must print to stdout on success for its "security scan" subcommand, per plugins/SECURITY-CONTRACT.md. Each entry is a regular CycloneDX vulnerability object (see https://cyclonedx.org/docs/ for its full schema, not re-specified here) describing something the scanned --purl is affected by. Validate a plugin's actual stdout output (one line, one array) against this schema to check it for structural conformance; it only constrains the bomify-specific parts (the array wrapper, and that affects is left for bomify to fill in), not every CycloneDX vulnerability field.

bom-ref.description: A stable identifier for this vulnerability (the vulnerability's own id is a reasonable choice). bomify merges two components' results that report the same bom-ref into a single entry, combining their affects — a vulnerability with no bom-ref is never merged with another.

id.description: The vulnerability's own identifier, e.g. a CVE or GHSA id.

affects.description: Must be omitted. bomify sets this itself, to the component currently being scanned, before merging results across every component in the SBOM.
